adjudication.rationale: In the migration, the category for existing `embed_category` is resolved via `SELECT c.id ... INNER JOIN site_settings AS s ON s.value = c.name WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'` and then uses `[0]['id']` without an `ORDER BY` (db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb). If multiple categories share the same `name` (possible for subcategories vs top-level since name uniqueness isn’t enforced globally), this query can return multiple rows and `[0]` will select an arbitrary one, causing migrated `embeddable_hosts` rows to be assigned to the wrong category.
